name: Great Orme prehistoric copper mining
description: Archaeological remains at Great Orme record prehistoric copper-ore workings, including a passage with associated dated charcoal.

date.label: 1410–1070 BCE
date.basis: The dated event or object is the scoped witness, not a global invention date.

events.statement: Archaeological remains at Great Orme record prehistoric copper-ore workings, including a passage with associated dated charcoal.

evidence.supports: The historic environment record associates passage charcoal with the reported calibrated range 1410–1070 BCE and describes nearby tools and copper-ore workings.

events.caveats: The 1410–1070 BCE charcoal sample was found in a passage wall crevice; it dates that deposit, not the mine origin or full operating span. Part of the passage was reworked in the 18th or 19th century; the date does not measure production.

evidence.supports: Archaeological workings and tools support an interpretation of human mining, though individual operators are unidentified.
